reviewed_contract: Caller candidate is privately copied and input zeroed before admission; private candidate and exact decrypt readbacks are zeroed on exits.
Fresh production closed-vault exclusion plus native-proof orchestration; no Prepared/UUID/checksum-only activation capability.
Strict canonical bounded old/new staged reads, v1-only old decoder, matching UUID, exact increment/no overflow, preserved StrongBox policy and exact canonical encoding.
Both factor-specific operations authenticate exactly the supplied Cipher, bind record/factor AAD, and constant-time compare decrypted wraps to the newly proved candidate.

Each suspension is followed by cancellation/source/staged-byte/alias-existence revalidation; transaction callback repeats full authority checks outside monitor, cheap context.ensureActive runs at guarded admission.
Observed transaction outcomes survive post-rename cancellation/cleanup failures; no provider currentKey/session/token publication, alias deletion/create, database write or automatic rollback.
Actual source/test scope is exactly two new files; legacy preparation/decoder/provider/session remain unchanged.

resolved_findings.finding: Already-authenticated earlier alias could disappear during later authentication without detection.
resolved_findings.resolution: Both expected aliases are checked at evidence/auth/final validation checkpoints; deterministic deletion during second auth and BEFORE_RENAME is refused.

resolved_findings.finding: Repeated host fixtures shared fixed UUID aliases and one keystore, causing legitimate collision refusal on later fixture setup.
resolved_findings.resolution: Each fixture constructs an independent RecordingKeystore; no old aliases are deleted to reset fixtures.
